articleTitle: LES Analysis on the Impact of Mass Conservation Uncertainty on the Static Pressure Fluctuation in Spatially Periodic Steady Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This study investigates the effect of mass-conserving uncertainty on the static pressure fluctuation characteristics in incompressible isotropic steady turbulence. The mass conservation uncertainty can be produced by relaxing the convergence of the Poisson equation solved in the fractional stages. This mass-conserving uncertainty may often be found acceptable in fluid analysis. In incompressible flows, the mass conservation uncertainty is quantified as the spatial variation RMS of the velocity divergence. The analysis is analyzed as a large-eddy simulation, and the SGS components are modelled using the Smagorinsky and coherent structure models. First, the steady-state turbulence generated in the case without mass-conserving uncertainty is tested to be independent of the differences between these SGS models. Then the spatial fluctuation RMS of the velocity divergence is validated to be significant.

articleTitle: Communication Latency Optimization Through Hardware-Direct Design in Modular Development
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Ensuring safety, reliability, and comfort is paramount in deploying autonomous driving technologies. An integrated system of information and communication technologies supports these objectives. While advances in modular development have facilitated functional verification and enhanced the extensibility and reusability of design assets, a significant challenge remains the reduction of communication latency caused by module arbitration. Latency is a critical performance metric for real-time systems, and failure to meet specified latency requirements can compromise the viability of these systems. This article presents an empirical study on the latency incurred through hardware-direct operations in a communication framework based on conventional network standards. Utilizing a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) design, we incorporated image processing and data compression algorithms, executing all operations through hardware-direct computation. Our experimental results indicate latencies of approximately 230 µs in wired environments and 4,340 µs in wireless settings. Given that the internal computational delay within the FPGA was less than 100 µs, our findings substantiate the efficacy of employing FPGA in modular development for latency-sensitive applications.

articleTitle: Design of a System for Near-Infrared Composite Spectral Image Acquisition and Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The NIR camera is a device that captures images within the near-infrared spectral range, typically operating wavelengths from 700nm to 2500nm. The camera can possess exceptional penetrating capability and achieve multi-functions, making it a prominent subject of research and application in the industrial sector. The paper provides the system for near-infrared composite spectral image acquisition and information processing which is based on the Alvium 1800 U-130 VSWIR camera by Allied Vision. The system leverages QT Creator to establish an efficient and robust software platform with a user-friendly interface, facilitating NIR image acquisition and information processing across wavelengths ranging from 400 nm to 1700 nm. It is also equipped with narrow band filters for 940 nm, 1450 nm, and 1550 nm. The system effectively tackles challenges regarding the prevention of illegal copying, counterfeiting and infringement areas, detection of water content, differentiation of similar objects, and penetrability. Moreover, it offers practical applications in areas such as anti-counterfeiting measures, food safety assurance, and industrial processes.

articleTitle: Digital Process Design and Simulation of Slush Molding Based on Tecnomatix
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In the product development process, manufacturing flexibility requirements continue to increase, and with the emergence and development of digital twin technology, virtual scenes can be created to observe, analyze, and predict data. Compared with traditional models, the risk is lower and the investment cost is lower. The slush molding process is one of the important processes in the production of automotive interiors, and the difficulty of improving the process is particularly prominent. Based on the Tecnomatix Plant Simulation software, this paper digitally designed the slush molding process, built the corresponding simulation model and logic program, and carried out the production scheduling simulation according to the production work order; then used the simulation experiment method to optimize the process parameters, and after comparing the simulated production capacity data with the actual production capacity, the accuracy of the model is verified, and finally, the production capacity prediction under different production requirements can be realized, which can effectively reduce the cost of process improvement.

articleTitle: Suspension Performance Analysis of an All-Wheel Steering Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Aiming at the need of an all-wheel-steering mobile robot to walk in farmland, the suspension device of an all-wheel-steering mobile robot is analyzed. First, the mathematical model of the robot quarter suspension is established, the model parameters are optimized and the robot's driving performance on random roads is verified by MATLAB simulation experiments. Then, the effect of the all-wheel steering capability of this robot on the suspension system was explored through MATLAB simulation experiments. The experimental results show that the suspension system with optimized parameters has good driving performance. The all-wheel steering capability of this robot affects the suspension system, which puts forward higher requirements for suspension system optimization and improvement.

articleTitle: Design of Universal Integrated Robot Joint and Its Applications in Multiple Fields
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This article mainly focuses on the design and prototype development of a universal integrated joint, and analyzes the design of the joint and the motor used. By verifying and optimizing weak materials such as enameled wires, heat shrink tubes, and lead wires, and applying them to the entire product, core components such as motors and rotary transformers can have a longer lifespan in complex environments. At the same time, universal interfaces are designed for joints to ensure that integrated joints can be widely used in various fields such as rehabilitation, medical exoskeletons, and nuclear industrial robots. Finally, practical use cases are provided in the article.

articleTitle: Large Eddy Simulation Study on the Sub-Grid Scale Model Constant Value Relationship in Homogeneous Steady Turbulence based on Large Scale Turbulence Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This study presents a relationship between values of model constants of two sub-grid scale (SGS) models, the Smagorinsky and Vreman models, in large-eddy simulation (LES). This relationship, already presented in the previous study, is examined using a statistically steady isotropic turbulence field. A value of the model constants can be varied to the spatial scale of the external force field that maintains turbulence. The present values of the two model constants for each condition are calculated by calibrating with those obtained using a spectral method with identical turbulence field conditions. A functional form of the relationship between these values of the two model constants agreed with that of the previous study. However, obtained values of the coefficient of it were significantly different. The present study considers that this result implies that a value of the coefficients in the relationship between the model constants may depend on in turbulence fields.

articleTitle: Research on Ground Comprehensive Observation Monitoring and Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and society, China has carried out a large amount of research work in realizing the intelligence and automation of ground meteorological comprehensive observation in order to promote meteorological modernization, and has achieved significant results. Due to the influence of natural environment, equipment status, network conditions, and other factors, observation element data is prone to anomalies, and station operators are unable to continuously monitor ground comprehensive observation software 24 hours a day. In the event of equipment failures, data anomalies, and other situations, it is easy for city and county-level ground comprehensive observation to fail to detect problems in a timely manner, affecting the timely investigation and maintenance of fault points. This article studies the status monitoring and alarm software for ground comprehensive observation elements, monitors ground meteorological comprehensive observation data in real time, and sends SMS alarms when data transmission is abnormal, effectively improving the timeliness of grassroots equipment support, enhancing ground comprehensive observation capabilities, and providing reliable basic data for meteorological information services and analysis and prediction of meteorological stations.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization on Production Mode of Aeroengine Bearing Assembly Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of multiple varieties of aeroengine bearing assembly, the flow assembly cell is studied, and the practical method for guiding of cells construction- “PADIK” method is proposed and applied, which focuses on the takt design of mixed line cell, production process reengineering, production line balance, production line layout and logistics design. The mathematical model of linear programming is constructed and LINGO is applied to solve the optimal solution of the whole system. The smoothing index of the whole system is the lowest and the waste is the least. Through the verification of practical cases, the core operation indicators such as production cycle, WIP and product quality have been improved effectively, which verifies the effectiveness of this method and has the significance of popularization.

articleTitle: Multiple Objects Detection and Localization using Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Real-time object detection is one of the most fundamental computer vision processes, it is of great importance for many applications, such as video surveillance and autonomous driving. Object detection with multiple modalities of data is of great importance as it provides more information about the surrounding objects. Most 3D object detection approaches are based on utilizing expensive sensors and/or high computational requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a low-cost real-time multiple objects detection platform using a low-cost 2D-LiDAR and an RGB camera. YOLOv3 has been adopted as the object detection algorithm, moreover, a novel calibration technique has been proposed to achieve mapping between the camera and LiDAR. Experiments were made on real-world scenarios; the performance of the system was validated by manually measuring the distances of detected objects. The system outputs surrounding objects along with their classification and their 3D location in the scene.

articleTitle: Improved Mapping Technique Based on ORB-SLAM2 in Dynamic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: At present, in the simultaneous localization and map construction (SLAM) algorithm, the more mature technology is the map construction in the static environment. However, there are currently moving objects in most environments, which will affect the accuracy and integrity of slam mapping. In this paper, we propose an improved vision SLAM based on ORB-SLAM2 that adds an independent parallel target detection thread to effectively filter low dynamic objects in the scene. Finally, we conduct an experimental evaluation using the TUM dataset, and the results show that our algorithm has a great improvement over ORB-SLAM2 in positioning accuracy and running time.

articleTitle: Discrimination of the Near-Fault Pulse-Like Seismic Motions Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Identification of near-fault pulse-like seismic motions are an important part of engineering seismic design. In recent years, the rapidly developing deep learning algorithm, with its powerful data feature mining and image recognition ability, can quickly and accurately constrain the attributes of earthquake events. By inputting seismic wave data and seismic time-frequency data, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to obtain the waveform and spectral features of the seismic events, thereby constructing an automatic classification network model based on the CNN algorithm for near-fault pulse-like earthquakes and non-near-fault pulse-like earthquakes. Based on the observed data of near-fault pulse earthquakes and non-near-fault pulse-like earthquakes recorded in the NGA-West2 strong-motion database, a deep learning training model is constructed and the model is trained to determine known near-fault pulse earthquakes. The results show that the CNN based on time-frequency data has a high recognition accuracy, with a recognition rate of up to 91.59%.

articleTitle: Multimodal Spatiotemporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for Extracting Metadata for Artwork Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: As AI-generated art becomes more common, it becomes increasingly important to distinguish between works created by humans and those created by machines. This is essential for collectors, galleries, auction houses and museums. In this paper, we propose a convolutional neural network classifier for multimodal spatiotemporal graphs using metadata analysis. Key features are obtained by examining metadata obtained from digital artworks, including potential time spent on digital artwork, stroke order, and color selection, etc. These variables are then combined with digital artworks to form a data set, and digital art Item metadata is projected onto the graph structure, and then a multimodal spatiotemporal graph convolutional neural network classifier is employed to make classification decisions and generate spatiotemporal signatures of multimodal digital artworks. And the model is tested with other models on the existing digital artwork data set, and indicators such as F-1 score and Accuracy are obtained. The test results show that the method is superior in these indicators.

articleTitle: An Aerial Target Intention Recognition Method Based on Improved Evidence Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: To overcome the problem that uncertainty was ignored in the process of traditional aerial target intention recognition, this paper proposed a method of aerial target intention recognition based on improved evidence network. Firstly, an evidence network structure model for aerial target intention recognition is constructed based on the attributes of aerial targets. Then, a belief rule activation method is proposed to obtain the target intention by inferring layer by layer. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Augmented Reality Technology for Interactive Display of Clothing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In this paper, the intelligent mobile terminal is used as the carrier, facing the engineering application of clothing design, production, and sales enterprises, in order to improve the immersion experience and innovation promotion of clothing products, focusing on the image processing, model database construction, display interaction design technology. It solves the problems that the limited speed of image recognition and the poor realism of clothing model in the mobile terminal, overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional clothing display system, such as weak real-time interaction, time, and space limitations, and innovates the clothing display, design, and application promotion mode.

articleTitle: A 6–18-GHz Broadband Digital-Stepped Phase Shifter MMIC with Low In-Band Phase Error
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This paper presents a 6–18-GHz Broadband 6-bit digital stepped phase shifter monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) with low in-band phase error. A reflective type phase shifter topology with phase variation compensation capacitor in the reflective loads is proposed to reduce in-band phase error. Improved unfolded Lange couplers are used to ensure the symmetry of the phase shifter. The broadband phase shifter has been fabricated in 0.25-μm GaAs pHEMT technology. Measurement results show that the phase shifter exhibits 6.8‒9.6-dB insertion loss over 6‒18-GHz. The 6-bit phase shifter achieves an RMS phase error of 3.7° and an RMS amplitude error of 0.46-dB over 6‒18-GHz. The proposed phase shifter, which is able to cover X- and Ku-bands, is a good candidate for broadband phased array applications.

articleTitle: Diet Planning Models Based on Linear Programming Theory for Catering Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: As residents attach more and more importance to healthy diet, the catering problem has garnered widespread public attention. Nutrient-based dietary planning can give viable dietary recommendations for the above problems. In this paper, this study establishes a dietary planning model to find the minimum dietary expenditure under the condition that the daily nutritional requirements of diabetic patients are met and the upper limit of nutrient intake is not exceeded. Employing a dependable mathematical model, we make viable planning for diverse social groups and varied food materials, so as to give viable recommendations to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: Utilizing Lyapunov-Based Model Predictive Control to Achieve Dynamic Positioning for the Haizhe Autonomous Underwater Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the application of a Lyapunov-Based Model Predictive Control (LBMPC) framework in achieving dynamic positioning (DP) using the Haizhe autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) as a case study. Moreover, addressing the thrust allocation (TA) subproblem and optimizing DP control, LBMPC considers real-world restrictions. It makes use of a Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller, which ensures stability in the closed-loop system and continual feasibility within the system. Furthermore, attaining an extensive region of attraction, the contraction constraint improves stability. Control theory and optimization techniques are integrated into the framework, enabling smooth online optimization integration for enhanced control performance. The success of this strategy is shown by simulation findings on the Haizhe AUV, which represents a breakthrough in underwater vehicle control.

articleTitle: Cracking Causes of Dissimilar Steel Butt Joint of a High Temperature Superheater Tube in a Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: A T91/TP347H dissimilar steel butt joint of high temperature superheater tube of a 630 MW power plant unit was found cracked after 100,000 hours of operation. The reasons of cracking were analyzed by macroscopic examination, chemical composition analysis, metallographic examination, hardness test, scanning electron microscope (SEM) and energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) analysis. The results show that the misuse of welding materials is the root cause of the cracking. The excessive protrusion of the weld root and abnormal carburizing layer near the fusion line are the direct causes of the cracking. In view of the causes of cracking, it is suggested to strengthen the supervision of welding process, improve the welding quality and strictly control the heat treatment process.

Author Keywords: excessive protrusion of the weld root

articleTitle: DADN: Data Augmentation-Driven Dual Network Framework for Node Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Node classification is an important task in graph neural networks (GNNs), aiming to predict the category of nodes in the graph according to their neighbours and their own characteristics. Current methods mainly focus on one level of data augmentation, ignoring huge potential in other underlying levels. Furthermore, existing models cannot fully exploit the information contained in the existing data, which undermines the performance of node classification. In order to solve the above problems, we propose a novel Data Augmentation-driven Dual Network (DADN) framework. Specifically, we first design a composite data augmentation module that comprehensively considers the local neighborhood level, the node level, and the edge level to augment the original features. Then, we copy the original features and the augmented features into the dual network framework with dropout for model training to capture the innermost features. Finally, we experimentally evaluate our method on three real-world public datasets, and the results show that our method outperforms the baseline models in the node classification task, except for individual metrics.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electromechanical Coupling: A Modified Model for Studying Uterine Myometrial Contraction
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The mechanism of uterine electromyographic signals and mechanical contractions is a significant research topic. In this study, we propose a novel electromechanical model that utilizes the FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) model to simulate the enhanced excitability of uterine cells influenced by hormones, leading to the successful generation of pacemaker behavior upon the introduction of small perturbations. Furthermore, we observe that as pregnancy progresses, enhanced gap junction, anchoring junction, and electromechanical coupling activity contributes to global mechanical contraction synchronization. Our research results also demonstrate a considerable level of synchronization between electrical and mechanical signals, providing robust theoretical support for the practical application of electrical signals. These findings deepen our understanding of electromechanical coupling effects and offer new perspectives for research and applications in related fields.

articleTitle: Advancements in Small-Scale Fuel Cell Controller Evolution through Automated Code Generation: A Scientific Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The fuel cell controller, positioned at the core of the fuel cell system, orchestrates control and monitoring functions to ensure operational efficiency and stability. This paper outlines the design of a fuel cell controller characterized by robust versatility, abundant peripherals, and cost-effectiveness, leveraging the STM32F407 platform. Subsequently, a comprehensive suite of automatic code generation strategies, centered on Waijung1 within the Simulink environment, is introduced, streamlining algorithm development. These methodologies are then employed to rigorously experiment and validate the controller's performance. The test results showcase the controller's elevated precision in signal output and data detection. The output signal error remains under 0.1%, the captured signal error is contained within 0.4%, the sensor error is restricted to less than 1.5%, and the overall controller cost is reduced by 25%-30%, attesting to the precision and cost-effectiveness of the system. The automatic code generation solution significantly reduces the software development cycle by more than 30% compared to traditional C language development approaches, highlighting significant advancements in efficiency.

articleTitle: A Double Strategy Improved Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In order to accelerate the convergence speed and accuracy of the artificial bee colony algorithm, a double strategy improved artificial bee colony algorithm is proposed, and validate with classical testing functions. Firstly, using tent chaotic mapping, random numbers are generated during the search process to increase the diversity, and reverse learning is used to improve the quality of solutions, allowing the algorithm to explore more solution spaces during the search process; Then, an adaptive elite guidance strategy is introduced during the hiring bee search process, utilizing the global optimal individual and elite individual guidance algorithm to improve the accuracy and speed of the algorithm's search direction; Finally, the proposed algorithm was validated using classical testing functions and demonstrated good performance and effectiveness in solving optimization problems. It can be confirmed that the proposed algorithm has significant advantages in overcoming premature convergence, improving convergence accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Vehicle Formation Matching and Simulation in Cooperative Vehicle Infrastructure System Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that independent vehicles can choose the best formation to join, this paper proposes a vehicle formation matching strategy in cooperative vehicle infrastructure system (CVIS). Firstly, a description of the formation matching problem in the highway scenario is given, and secondly, the objective function of the formation matching problem is constructed and the corresponding constraints are set. In this way, matching algorithms for centralised and distributed formations are obtained. Finally, based on the set conditions, the formation matching strategy in the scenario of this paper is simulated and verified. The results show that based on the proposed formation matching strategy, the pass time is reduced by 381s and the energy consumption is improved by 38.7%,31.8%,40.6%,26.2%,22.1% and 29.4% in different degrees. This implies that the formation matching strategy, is more effective in selecting the best formation to join, resulting in a more efficient and energy-efficient traffic system.

articleTitle: Application of Multidimensional Information in Predicting Blue Side Attack Actions: A Matching Degree Calculation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In response to the problem of difficulty in accurately predicting the intention of blue troops to attack targets on the land battlefield, this paper proposes a prediction method based on matching degree, aiming to predict the intention of blue troops to attack. This article adopts a comprehensive analysis method based on multidimensional information to analyze the matching degree between the blue attacking force and the possible targets of the red side. Firstly, integrate the features of the blue attacking force obtained from the battlefield with the feature information of the red potential target to form a panel of data. Next, the position matching degree, marching angle matching degree, and force target matching degree between the troops and the target are calculated separately, in order to establish the matching degree relationship between the blue attacking troops and the possible attacked targets of the red side, and then use it to speculate on the probability of the blue army implementing the attack, thereby achieving the prediction of the target of the blue attacking action. Finally, an example analysis shows that this matching degree-based prediction method can more comprehensively consider the fusion of multi-dimensional intelligence information, which helps to improve the reliability and effectiveness of target attack prediction.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of Dual Active Full Bridge DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The efficiency of a bidirectional full-bridge DCDC converter is determined by the magnitude of the reverse power and inductor current stress. Although the presence of inner current shifting in the DPS control reduces the reverse power and inductor current stress, the reduction effect is not significant. Consequently, this research paper employs the approach of constructing the Lagrange function to segmentally optimize and regulate the inductor current stress and reverse power of single-phase shift (SPS) and double-phase shift (DPS) DC-DC converters. The objective is to minimize the inductor current stress and reverse power, thereby enhancing the converter's efficiency. A comparative analysis is conducted on the reverse power and inductor current stress of different optimization strategies. The feasibility and effectiveness of these strategies are verified through simulation on the MATLAB/Simulink platform, and the efficacy of relevant optimization algorithms is ultimately confirmed through experimentation on a dedicated platform.

articleTitle: Grasping Control of Planar Mechanical Claw
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The topic of our research is the grasping strategy of a planner two-joint mechanical claw. Our inspiration comes from a paper on the grasping strategy of soft things by a rigid mechanical hand. If we can get the force sensor's accurate data, how can we process these data to grasp an object correctly? In order to achieve our goal, we built a model of a mechanical hand on Matlab with two joints for each finger. We calculate many functions to process the data and simulate the model. With this model, we get our results. We get the evaluation of parameters alpha1 and alpha2, L, and tau. We increase the robustness of the entry of L. The mechanical claw can grasp a ball steadily and reach the stable point faster.

articleTitle: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Performance Decay Prediction Based on Relieff and Long Short-term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The PEMFC performance decay are closely linked to fuel cell maintenance and energy management. Existing PEMFC performance decay prediction algorithms generally have the problem of single feature selection, which cannot adapt to multiple operating conditions. In order to better predict attenuation under multiple operating conditions, this paper proposes a degradation prediction method based on the combination of Relieff's feature selection algorithm and the LSTM network, where Relieff selects the parameters that have high correlation with the degradation of the performance according to the operating parameters of the different conditions as the inputs of the LSTM prediction model in order to make this model more effective. The method's prediction performance is validated using real PEMFC experimental data. The experimental results confirm that the model can effectively selects attenuation-related indicators as input for LSTM, thereby enhancing the accuracy of the PEMFC performance prediction method across various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Cryogenic Tribological Properties of Bearings by Surface Micro-texture Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: As one of the core components of rotating equipment, bearing is easy to wear under cryogenic conditions, short life and other problems will seriously affect the efficiency of the entire equipment. To further improve bearing stability and reduce bearing wear, 3 types of micro-textures were designed and prepared on bearing contact surface by fiber laser processing technology, and friction and wear tests were carried out on the three micro-textures under cryogenic conditions. The results show that the flute-channel micro-texture has better anti-friction and anti-wear characteristics under cryogenic conditions, and the anti-friction and anti-wear effects are better with the increase of load. In addition, compared with the type 1 and type 2 micro-textures, the type 3 micro-texture can better collect and transfer the abrasive particles and impurities mixed in the interface by means of the unique channel structure connected between grooves, reducing the abrasive debris retention on the surface of the friction pair. The research not only ensures the stable contact of the friction interface, but also effectively inhibits the occurrence of abrasive wear on the surface of the friction pair, which provides theoretical and technical support for further improving the bearing stability and improving the bearing life.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of An Avalanche Photodiode Device for Rare Earth Fluorescence Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The gain and spectral response range of photodiodes are very important for rare earth fluorescence detection. However, traditional photodiodes do not have internal gain, which cannot meet the requirements of the above fields. Therefore, an avalanche photodiode is designed and manufactured based on 0.18 μm CMOS process in this paper. N+/P-Well forms the avalanche multiplication region of the device, which is used for the detection of external photons. N-Well is used as the guard ring of the device to prevent the breakdown of the side junction of N+/P-Well. In addition, the principle of the device is verified based on Technology-Computer-Aided-Design (TCAD) simulation. The test results show that the avalanche breakdown voltage of the device is 11.7 V. When the reverse bias voltage is 11.7V, the dark current of the device is 9.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> A, and the photocurrent of the device is 3.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> A. The current after the avalanche breakdown of the device is 1 mA. The spectral response range of the device is 400 nm-1000 nm, the peak is 470 nm, and the responsivity is 6.7 A/W.

articleTitle: Community Detection in Signed Networks Based on Normalized Laplacian Matrix and Convex Non-negative Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Signed networks can intuitively and flexibly describe the positive and negative interactions among entities in a complex network. Community structure detection is a basic research topic of signed network analysis, which is of theoretical significance and practical value to reveal the organizational structure, functional structure, and individual behavior of complex systems. However, it is still a challenging task to accurately detect the community structure in a signed network. In this paper, we design a community detection algorithm based on normalized Laplacian matrix and convex non-negative matrix factorization for signed networks. The proposed algorithm applies convex non-negative matrix decomposition to a signed network, and decomposes the adjacency matrix of the network into a community membership matrix and a node weight matrix. Meanwhile, the algorithm introduces normalized Laplacian graph regularization terms to reduce noise generated during the decomposition process. Experimental results verify that the proposed algorithm is effective in community detection.

articleTitle: Dual-Path Neural Networks Enabled Fetal ECG Extractions From Abdominal Electrohysterograpgy
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Fetal heart monitoring is crucial for the early detection of potential risks to fetal health conditions. However, the non-invasive fetal heart monitoring technology using maternal abdominal electrocardiography (AECG) is susceptible to interference from maternal electrocardiography (MECG) and multi-source noise. To address the above challenge, we propose a novel Dual-path Encoder-Decoder Model to extract fetal electrocardiography (FECG) signals from maternal abdominal recordings. It can effectively separate and remove MECG interference to obtain FECG. Additionally, a Feature Augmentation Module based on attention-guided is introduced to optimize the quality of the remaining features after MECG removal. Finally, the optimized features are fed into a decoder with external skip connections to reconstruct the FECG signal. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves outstanding performance on two public datasets, providing an effective solution for fetal health monitoring and assisting physicians in diagnosing fetal abnormalities.

articleTitle: Research on Phase Analysis Method of Fused Security Concept Based on Collaborative Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In order to identify the dependencies and conflicts among functional safety, safety of the intended functionality and cyber security within the domain of automotive electronics and electrical fields, and to establish a unified safety framework and analysis specifications, this paper proposes a research on a phased analysis method of safety fusion concepts based on collaborative trees analysis. Hazard analysis and risk assessment are conducted by defining collaborative-related items, utilizing collaborative Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) or collaborative Technical Safety Analysis (TARA) to ascertain safety goals. Subsequently, through the integration of Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) and Causal Tree Analysis (CTA), functional safety and safety of the intended functionality goals are systematically decomposed. The overall safety goal is further broken down into events associated with functional safety and safety of the intended functionality; The fusion of Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) with Attack Tree Analysis (ATA) is employed to decompose the functional safety and information security goals. This process dissects the overall safety goals into events related to functional safety and cyber security, providing a basis and prerequisite for subsequent collaborative design. Finally, the fusion safety goals are derived based on the collaborative safety goals derived from the collaborative analysis. The proposed fusion analysis method can comprehensively consider the interrelationships and constraints of various types of safety, improve overall safety, form a standardized and unified safety framework, and improve development efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Circle Center Positioning Algorithm Based on Mean Shift Method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of long-time consumption and low accuracy in the circle center positioning algorithm, a circle center positioning algorithm based on Mean Shift is proposed. Firstly, the grid method is used to segment the contour of a circle, forming a large number of small arcs. Secondly, a dataset of selected center points is constructed using small arcs, which are likely to fall near the neighborhood of true circle center points. Finally, a fast Gaussian kernel function with adaptive bandwidth is introduced to solve the weight problem of sample points, and the Mean Shift clustering algorithm is used to calculate the optimal solution for the data density of the selected circle center sample. This algorithm eliminates bad data from the dataset, resulting in higher positioning accuracy. The validation experimental results show that the circle center positioning algorithm takes the least time, and has an accuracy improvement of 23% compared to the Hough transform and 16% compared to the circle fitting algorithm.

articleTitle: Human Behavior Analysis in Virtual Environment for Human-Robot Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of robot technology, there will be more and more opportunities for humans and robots to work together in the future. In order to enable robots and humans to better complete collaborative tasks, the analysis of human behavior is very important. Robots should make up for the lack of human work ability. weak parts, thereby helping humans complete tasks quickly and efficiently. This article designed three tasks of different difficulty through the VR simulation system and recorded the behavioral patterns of a single operator, thereby analyzing the tendency of people to ignore corners and other obscure locations during the search task, and to analyze the range that they have already inspected. Lack of clarity and subjective judgments are too obvious and lead to mission failure. At the same time, we compared the different performances of human behavior in human-machine collaborative tasks, and compared and analyzed various data, and concluded that robots are of little help to humans in simple tasks, robots can help to a certain extent in general tasks, and robots in difficult tasks will compensate for humans. Subjective thinking defects lead to higher task completion.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Trigger Mechanism for Adaptive Function Allocation and Its Application on Airborne Self-separation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: As the disadvantages of single trigger mechanism, this paper introduced a hybrid mechanism for adaptive function allocation. this mechanism proposed that the automation level of system should coordinate with task demand load (TDL) and mental load (ML), doing so by following some specific policies. To validate this mechanism, it was implicated on the function of airborne self-separation. The automation related to this function were categorized into three levels. Fuzzy logic was used when modeling the TDL and function allocator. At last, a analysis software was designed to illustrate the behavior of the hybrid mechanism under different task demand and pilots state.

articleTitle: The Research on Spray Trajectory Planning Issues Digest
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The problem of glaze coating spraying is one of the problems faced in the production practice. Uniform glaze coating can greatly improve the quality and aesthetic degree of ceramics, so how to spray evenly has become an important research object. For the material with smooth surface, we analyzed the spraying situation of the spray gun on the single point and single line, drew the spraying situation of the spray gun on a line, and determined the translation distance interval according to the actual needs, and calculated the best translation distance by enumeration method. For the surface, obviously the calculation formula for the plane is not applicable to the surface, we use the projection principle, through the reference surface area element to establish the surface area element, and finally determine the surface area thickness. Finally, the optimal translation distance is obtained.

articleTitle: Design of a Vehicle-level Test System for In-vehicle Emergency Call System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The in-vehicle emergency call system has the ability to decrease the waiting time for assistance following a car crash, resulting in a decreased fatality rate for road accidents. According to domestic and international regulations, it is necessary for the system to undergo comprehensive testing to ensure its reliability prior to being utilized in vehicles. The whole vehicle triggering characteristics serve as the final evaluation in the certification process, requiring strict testing and verification to guarantee the technology's maturity and dependability. This paper presents a vehicle-level test system designed to meet vehicle-level test requirements. The system was tested from four perspectives, including in-vehicle system (IVS) triggering characteristics, minimum set of data (MSD) correctness, positioning accuracy, and voice call quality. The experimental results indicate that the testing system effectively tests the whole vehicle triggering characteristics of the in-vehicle emergency call system, thereby confirming its efficacy. The testing system can offer a budget-friendly and productive emergency call (eCall) certification testing solution to automobile companies. Additionally, it can provide substantial technical and data support for the creation of mandatory standards in China. Consequently, it promotes the expansion of related domains in China.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of AUV under Current Disturbance Based on Adaptive LADRC
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In consideration of the trajectory tracking problem of autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) under external current disturbance, an adaptive linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) method is proposed. Unlike the conditional LADRC using fixed parameters for extended state observer, the proposed controller makes use of the error of estimation and automatically adjusts the parameter online. As shown in the simulation, the adaptive LADRC estimates the external current disturbance effectively, and tracks the 3D trajectory better compared with traditional LADRC.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Just-in-Time Learning Soft Sensor Modeling Method With a Density-Based Data Update Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, data-driven soft sensors are often used in industrial process quality control. In recent years, soft sensor modeling method based on just-in-time learning (JITL) has been widely studied and applied due to its strong adaptability to time-varying characteristics of processes, simple modeling principles, and easy implementation. However, when the working conditions of the production process migrate due to various reasons such as sensor drift, catalyst deterioration, and raw material changes, the historical data used for modeling may not cover the current working condition, and the performance of the JITL model will also sharply decline even fail. Therefore, this article proposes a density based modeling data adaptive update management mechanism under the JITL framework to effectively enhance the adaptive tracking ability of soft sensors for process condition migration, thereby maintaining the longterm effectiveness of the model in practical use. Finally, the advantages of the proposed method were verified through numerical simulation and comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Res-UNet Based Fetal Electrocardiogram Extraction via Time-Frequency Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The fetal heart rate variation serves as an effective means of fetal health monitor. Although can be captured through abdominal electrocardiogram (AECG) of pregnant women, the AECG signal contains interference from maternal heart activity and other sources. Due to the higher-amplitude maternal ECG (MECG), the waveform of the fetal ECG (FECG) is obscured, making FECG separation challenging. However, the similarity of the frequency patterns of both types of ECG signals implies the possibility of reconstructing FECG using the frequency and the strength information of FECG. To this end, we employ the short-time Fourier transform (STFT) to convert the AECG signal into its time-frequency representation, and utilize a neural network model for extracting FECG from the time-frequency domain. The model can obtain high-quality FECG by capturing the amplitude differences between fetal and maternal heartbeats in different frequency components of AECG. Moreover, a combined time-domain and frequency-domain loss is introduced to enhance the model's separation performance. The proposed method is validated on public databases and demonstrates outstanding performance, providing an effective and feasible solution for non-invasive monitoring of fetal health.

articleTitle: A Novel Feature Emphasis Mechanism on Traffic Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is a challenging application in temporal prediction, especially in a small amount of dataset. Recently, most of the studies are based on a large data set, which will lead the huge waste of resources and time. In the case of small data sets, some state-of-the-art models cannot achieve the desired results due to the large deficiency of features. In this work, the main idea is to use our proposed Feature Emphasis Mechanism (FEM) to augment, re-extract and emphasis the small amount features by using Linear-Emphasis (LE) and Conv-Emphasis (CE). To capture and emphasis features more effectively, we apply Bi-training to capture the parameters in model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Feature Emphasis Mechanism can be applied to classical models, and improves the prediction accuracy in small dataset background.

articleTitle: A Study of Multi-Beam Bathymetric Based on Geometric Intuition and Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Multi-beam survey technology breaks through the limitations of traditional survey technology and greatly improves the accuracy of seabed topographic survey, resolution and work efficiency, realizing a revolutionary breakthrough in the history of bathymetric technology. This paper firstly uses the geometric intuitive method, applying similar triangles, sine and cosine theorems and other tools to calculate the depth of seawater, and the coverage width of the two indicators. For the overlap rate, we give the exact definition of the formula for the seabed slope and calculate it. And then, the relationship between the original slope and the changed slope is found by looking for geometric relationships between slopes. We proceeded to improve the model in Phase 1 under this condition so as to obtain the formula for the relevant index. At last, we consider a rectangular sea area, and carry out the survey line design under the condition of guaranteeing the maximum overlap rate (i.e., ensuring that the survey line can cover all the sea area). We first determine the preliminary wiring when the ship sails from south to north, and then calculate the total length of the line at different angles by changing the angle between the line and the projection of the normal vector of the seabed slope in the horizontal plane, and finally get the final line design results.

articleTitle: Indoor Following Model Based on TDOA Positioning and Q-Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This paper presents an indoor tracking algorithm model designed specifically for the unique scenario of supermarkets. Firstly, the UWB positioning technology is utilized to replace the RFID radio frequency positioning due to its superior performance in all aspects. Additionally, to account for the vast area of supermarkets, the TDOA algorithm is employed to cluster and combine all UWB positioning base stations, thereby reducing non-line-of-sight errors and improving the overall positioning accuracy. Furthermore, the supermarket is abstracted into a two-dimensional plane with insurmountable obstacles, and the Q-learning algorithm and its improved version are utilized to obtain the optimal and suboptimal paths between two points in the supermarket, which can be used to determine the general direction of travel. In the event of obstacles along the travel path, the DWA algorithm is employed to perform local dynamic obstacle avoidance, ultimately achieving the goal of shopping cart tracking.

articleTitle: A Highway Entrance Ramp Control Method Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Considering the intricate traffic flow dynamics between the mainline and entrance ramp areas of highways, a ramp control model based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is proposed. Leveraging the characteristics of traffic flow, this study builds upon existing reinforcement learning (RL) ramp control models and optimizes the design of the state space, action space, and reward function. Utilizing the PyCharm platform, SUMO simulation software is adopted for secondary development. Simulation experiments are conducted in various scenarios involving different congestion durations and demand distributions. Under identical road network conditions, four distinct control methods are devised: the no-control (NC) scenario, the ALINEA ramp control method, the RL control method, and the proposed DRL method. The experimental outcomes indicate that, compared to the NC method, all three alternative methods substantially reduce the average travel time. The proposed DRL method exhibits an average travel time reduction of 12.77% compared to the ALINEA method and a 5.22% reduction compared to the RL method. Furthermore, the proposed DRL method achieves a reduction of approximately 39.01% in the ramp queue length compared to the ALINEA method.

articleTitle: Quantized Stabilization of Neutral Systems with Time-varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The quantized stabilization is discussed for a neutral system with delay of time-varying in this paper. In the first place, a suitable Lyapunov functional is constructed, and a stability criterion that has less conservativeness is given by utilizing the negative determinative property of the quadratic function and matrices of free-weighting. Furthermore, the strategy of quantized control is added to the neutral system with delay of time-varying to optimize the structure and improve the transmission rate of the network. Then, the designed state quantized controller can maintain stabilization of the neutral system with time delay. Finally, an example of numerical is given which verifies the feasibility of the result.

articleTitle: A Review of Security Threats and Response Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: To gain a deeper understanding of the security problems of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), to analyze the current developments, and to enhance their vulnerability, this paper introduced knowledge about WSNs, analyzed the various attacks faced by WSNs, and proposed a set of solutions based on network security techniques. Additionally, WSNs security solutions such as key management, route management, and digital signatures are explored and concluded. Finally, several techniques to protect against attacks at various levels of WSNs are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Odometry of Planar Motion Wheeled Robot Based on RGB-D Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Based on the motion characteristics of the planar motion wheeled robot with RGB-D camera, the contour constraint conditions were proposed in the image processing part of visual odometer to screen out the mismatched feature points, and a new calculation method was proposed in the inter-frame motion calculation part. Firstly, the contour constraint condition was established according to the motion constraint of the planar wheeled robot camera. This constraint condition could not only screen out the color map mismatch, but also screen out the matching point pairs with correct color map matching but large depth value error. Then, in the inter-frame motion calculation part of the camera, the transfer matrix was reduced in dimension and the least squares problem was constructed on the basis of linearization approximation. Finally, the linearization approximation calculation error was dynamically compensated to obtain the two-dimensional motion parameters of the robot camera. The experimental results showed that compared with RANSAC algorithm, the algorithm exhibited higher calculation accuracy. Compared with RANSAC algorithm and ICP algorithm, the operation time of this algorithm was reduced by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$89.08{{\% }}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$52.38{{\% }}$</tex>, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Escalator Based on Spectral Kurtosis and Envelope Demodulation Method Diagnosis and Application of Motor Bearing Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Based on spectral kurtosis theory and envelope demodulation method, a bandpass filter optimization algorithm is used to diagnose and analyze rolling bearing faults, and it is applied to the fault diagnosis of escalator motor bearings. The spectral kurtosis method is used to process the pre whitened raw data to determine the band range of bandpass filtering, and the envelope demodulation method is used to identify the bearing fault characteristic frequency. According to actual case data, the envelope demodulation method based on spectral kurtosis can effectively extract bearing fault impact signals. The pre whitening method using linear prediction models can further improve the signal to noise ratio of bearing weak fault impact signals. Therefore, this method provides a good analytical approach for fault diagnosis of rolling bearings in rotating machinery.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machine with SMOTE Based on Correlated Covariates
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In real data, imbalanced data and massive covariates usually bring large challenges and computational burdens in machine learning fields. The existing synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE) has been well developed to deal with the imbalanced data. To further improve computational efficiency, support vector machine (SVM) are modified to accomplish classifications only based on significantly correlated covariates rather than all the covariates. As comparisons, the paper uses different kernel functions in SVM with SMOTE to show their different performances.

articleTitle: Kinematic Analysis of 6-RSS Parallel Robot Designed for Assisting Cervical Laminectomy
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Cervical laminectomy is a kind of clinical surgery mainly used for decompression of a cervical vertebrate. Because of the limited space of the cervical vertebrate, this surgery requires surgeons to operate in a higher degree of accuracy. A robot-assisted surgery can always achieve good accuracy by virtue of precise positioning and operation of the robot, and a parallel robot can perform better accuracy due to its mechanism feature. A 6-RSS has a more concise structure and lower mass of moving parts than other types of parallel robots, thus it performs better in human-machine interaction which could guarantee precise operations of surgeons. But kinematic analysis of a 6-RSS parallel robot is normally more complicated than other types. In this paper, the theoretical mechanism model of the 6-RSS parallel robot was built and coordinates were defined. The kinematic model was derived based on the closed-loop kinematic chain. The dexterity indices were analyzed to facilitate the design process of the robot.

articleTitle: Research on Compensation Technology for Low-Voltage Distribution Network Under Distributed Photovoltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The three-phase load imbalance and asymmetric parameters in the low-voltage distribution network result in a certain degree of three-phase imbalance. The integration of single-phase distributed photovoltaics further exacerbates the imbalance and voltage violation risks. To address the issues of three-phase imbalance and voltage violation caused by distributed photovoltaic integration in low-voltage distribution networks, this paper investigates a method that combines intelligent reactive power compensators and DSTATCOM for control. The article first introduces the principle of voltage violation under photovoltaic integration. Then, it analyzes the balancing compensation principles of intelligent reactive power compensators and DSTATCOM, and proposes a suitable topology and control strategy for DSTATCOM integration in low-voltage distribution networks based on the characteristics of the distribution network structure. Finally, a simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink, and the simulation results demonstrate that the proposed control technology effectively resolves the three-phase imbalance issues caused by distributed photovoltaic integration in low-voltage distribution networks.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation System for the Sightings of Asian Giant Hornet
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This paper examines the reports of sightings of the Asian giant hornet by the Washington State Department of Agriculture, using 4,440 such reports and background information from Pennsylvania State University Extension on the insect. The study establishes a mathematical model for predicting short-term changes in the Asian giant hornet population and quantifies the relationship between public reports and actual pest populations. The resulting management system for sightings of the Asian giant hornet provides a theoretical basis for more effective pest prevention by the Department of Agriculture in Washington State.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Thermal Performance of Clothed Human under Different Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: China's current thermal comfort standards for the building environment are formulated according to international standards, which are not suitable for China's national conditions. Therefore, this study adopts comprehensive mathematical modeling and computer simulation technology, and uses a CAD system based on the thermal functional simulation model of the dressed human body to simulate to analyze the thermal performance of the human body under different conditions. This paper discussed: 1) By designing different activities simulation cases, analyze the segmental thermal indicators of clothed human; and 2) discuss the effect of clothing cover ratio to thermal performance of clothed human for each body segment.

articleTitle: Angular Velocity Estimation in Asymmetric IMU Array
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: This paper is primarily dedicated to the methodology for angular velocity estimation. Initially, a specific force equation is formulated utilizing an accelerometer to establish the relationship between a single Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and the centroid of the asymmetric array frame. Within this framework, a Bias-Estimation Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) method is employed to enhance the precision of angular velocity estimation. Additionally, the estimation of acceleration and angular acceleration is integrated to refine orientation within the Kalman filtering process. Moreover, to simulate the presence of IMU noise, the accelerometers' biases are estimated and treated as time-varying variables rather than fixed constants. A simulation study is conducted to demonstrate the validity and efficacy of the proposed angular velocity estimation methodologies.

articleTitle: Workspace Analysis of 6-RSS Parallel Robot to Assist Cervical Laminectomy
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Cervical laminectomy is a common clinical procedure to decompress the cervical spine. However, because of the limited operating space of cervical spine surgery, the surgeon's operation precision is required to be high. Robot-assisted surgery can usually achieve good precision by precise positioning and manipulation of the robot, while parallel robots can attain better precision due to their mechanical characteristics. Compared with other types of parallel robots, the 6-RSS has a simpler structure and lower mass of moving parts, and therefore performs better in human-robot interaction, which ensures the surgeon's precise operation. However, the kinematic analysis of 6-RSS parallel robots is usually more complicated than other types, making the workspace analysis difficult. In this paper, the theoretical mechanism model of the 6-RSS parallel robot was built and coordinates were defined. The workspace was analyzed to evaluate end rotation and movement ability, which can optimize the structural design and guide the robot design.

articleTitle: Research on Driving Reliability Evaluation Method under a Rainfall Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In view of the severe traffic safety situation, it is an important and urgent research to analyze the characteristics of traffic accidents, curb the high incidence of traffic accidents and reduce the harm degree of road traffic accidents. This paper takes the driving reliability of the traffic system under a rainfall environment as the research object, explores the concept and calculation method of each unit of the system and its overall reliability from the perspective of the system's composition, structure, function and coupling relationship, proposes the reliability evaluation model of the complex system, and conducts case studies. It lays a foundation for the establishment of a safety early-warning theory system of transportation systems under rainfall conditions based on reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Global Sizes and Cylindricity Errors Based on fminimax Optimization Function
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Based on the evaluation definitions of minimum circumscribed, maximum inscribed and minimum zone methods for global sizes and cylindricity errors of cylinder, the optimization objective function of the axis parameters of the reference cylindrical surfaces and the evaluation models of global sizes and cylindricity errors were built. The subprograms for the optimization objective functions of the axis parameters of the reference cylindrical surfaces and the evaluation of global sizes and cylindricity errors were written by using Matlab language. The roundness profiles of four cylindrical samples were extracted, and their global sizes and cylindricity errors were evaluated based on least square, minimum circumscribed, maximum inscribed and minimum zone methods. The evaluation results of the optimization characteristic values of fminimax optimization function were compared with those evaluated by using other optimization methods, and it turned out that the accuracy of the optimization objective characteristic values of fminimax optimization function are higher or equal to those evaluated by other optimization methods, which is suitable to the application in the evaluation of global sizes and cylindricity errors.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach to Identify Potential Human Factor Issues for the HMI of Flight Deck
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: A practical approach to identify potential human factor issues in the HMI design of flight deck has been proposed by integrating task analysis, human error analysis and human factor evaluation methods. It could be used in the early design stage to help identifying compliance risks. The proposed method has proven to be valuable in identifying potential human error issues during the development of flight deck. By effectively assessing and addressing these issues, the method helps to ensure compliance with Human Factor related regulatory requirements, thereby reducing the overall compliance risk associated with flight deck design.

articleTitle: CTA Measurement on the Frequency Response of a Grid Turbulence Fluctuation Measurement with a Focus on Bispectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The aim of this study is to investigate a triple correlation function and a bispectrum of a turbulent voltage fluctuation obtained by a constant-temperature hot-wire anemometer (CTA) in terms of frequency response adjustment. The triple correlation function of a velocity fluctuation is included in the Kármán-Hawarth equation, which is the governing equation for an autocorrelation function. The bispectrum is obtained by Fourier transforming this triple correlation function. The velocity fluctuations in this experiment are obtained for multi-scale grid turbulence, and time series of these voltage fluctuations are measured by the constant-temperature hot-wire anemometer based on a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> tungsten wire I probe. The sampling frequency is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50\text{kHz}$</tex> and an analogue low-pass filter of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$20\text{kHz}$</tex> is used. Firstly, two cases are set up using a square wave where the frequency response is adjusted or unadjusted and oscillating. The effect of the unadjusted response is seen in the power spectrum of the voltage fluctuations. The distributions of the triple correlation function are then compared with and without this response adjustment. The bispectrum of the voltage fluctuations is then shown to be insensitive to the presence or absence of the response adjustment.

articleTitle: Requirement Analysis of Intelligent Manufacturing Incentive Development Based on Securities Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: Analyzing the product needs of industries, enterprises, and residents through securities data and linking them with policies such as planning, subsidies, and current indicators can help the government and society better understand and predict the development status of the industry, and provide a basis for the government to make reasonable industrial adjustment and economic regulation decisions. A multi factor correlation analysis strategy was established using the identification and feature extraction techniques of correlation factors between securities information of intelligent manufacturing enterprises and macroeconomic data. On the one hand, it is possible to conduct socio-economic situation analysis based on multi time scale securities information of intelligent manufacturing industries/enterprises, and on the other hand, it can also achieve socio-economic situation prediction based on multidimensional securities information. It can provide a basis for the government to grasp the operation of industries, understand the macroeconomic situation, industrial structure distribution, and other current situations. On this basis, a strategy for promoting the development of the intelligent manufacturing industry has been proposed, which helps to solve problems such as difficult evaluation of policy implementation, difficult evaluation of policy effectiveness, and lack of evaluation methods for policy rationality, providing decision-making support for promoting the development of the intelligent manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation Method of Angularity and Position Errors for Plane Features
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: The plane features of part drawings may have such indications as angularity tolerance and/or position tolerance and additional symbols. In this paper, twelve kinds of angularity tolerance drawing indications and twenty-eight kinds of position tolerance drawing indications were given, and the evaluation models of angularity error and position error were established. Based on the models above, the program for evaluating angularity errors and position errors of plane features was developed. The simulated profiles of plane features for two samples were taken as an example, and twelve cases of angularity errors and twenty-eight cases of position errors were evaluated and analyzed. The analysis of the evaluation results showed that the evaluation results of partial angularity errors and position errors are quite different under the same datum plane and the same measured object, and both datum plane and toleranced object have obvious influences on the evaluation results of angularity errors and position errors. This research may help designers understand the meanings of angularity tolerance zones, position tolerance zones and their additional symbols and indicate drawings reasonably.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Coal Mine Equipment Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: There are many types of mechanical and electrical equipment in coal mines, and the management tasks are heavy. In order to improve the management level and utilization efficiency of equipment, this paper analyzes the main requirements of coal mine electromechanical equipment management, designs a business process for cross-departmental full-cycle equipment management, and uses the software layered architecture design method to develop a coal mine equipment management system based on ASP.NET and MySQL database. The system realizes the dynamic management of equipment information, and provides reliable technical support for the online management and efficient maintenance of equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Precision Control Strategy of Space-Borne Pointing Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: In order to achieve accurate imaging and positioning of targets with a wide field of view in the ocean, and to accomplish high-precision imaging in the region of space-borne point calibration, this article utilizes a design approach for controlling the position of a spatial pointing mirror based on closed-loop control using dual feedback of position and velocity. The article explains the composition of the system, the position closed-loop control algorithm, the angle solving method, and the quantization error. Aiming to address the issue of rounding errors in PWM, the software utilizes a delay correction compensation method for error compensation. The test results show that the design method can meet the requirements for high-precision pointing in orbit. This finding can serve as a reference for the subsequent development of high-precision pointing control software and similar products in space.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Milling on Parallel Machine Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Computer Engineering (ICARCE)
abstract: From the analysis of static and dynamic characteristics of parallel machine tools, it can be found that the stiffness and vibration response of machine tools in different positions are obvious, which will inevitably cause the phenomenon of instability in the milling process, so it is especially necessary to study the milling stability of parallel machine tools. First of all, this paper takes 6SPS parallel machine tool as the actual operation object, establishes the milling vibration model of its tool, and determines the key elements affecting the milling vibration model. The vibration signal of the parallel machine tool is collected through experiments, and the milling stability of the parallel machine tool is reflected by the method of expressing the vibration intensity through the root mean square of the vibration signal. The influence of milling parameters on milling stability under different positions is analyzed, and the spectral analysis method is adopted to identify the chattering phenomenon in the milling process. Finally, the weights of each milling parameter on vibration were determined by gray correlation analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Yipai App Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
